comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
It's sold for 140k ducats by the Millionaire NPC who appears from time to time in Omaha. He also sells Mysterious Bonanza Box (No.7) -- you can try to locate him by using this Railway_Event(UWO) guide: docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1CvSeFtHsnVrOpuwd0n0iudkTxy9nD3wuKiP4i5ojcB4/

Cheers.

wiki:
Omaha: Millionaire

He appears the 3rd day right after Thanks Giving Period(4-day event) on Railroad Schedule when the Emergent Capital Increase(ECI) doesn't occur.
